receipt.equivalence_review: CORRECT_REFUSAL: Replayed all nine queries exactly. The complete block listing and inspected MOSFET/ULN2003 sink contracts cannot provide the required three controlled half-bridges. Original refusal and hashes match; this is catalog-bounded, not physical infeasibility.

refusal.reason: The pinned catalog has no eligible block implementing the requested motor.three-phase-bldc function. I inspected the IDs, categories and verification levels of all 47 blocks returned by the unfiltered catalog query, not just the empty motor/three-phase searches. Actual alternative switch contracts do not provide the required three independently commanded sourcing/sinking/floating phase outputs: block:g2-low-side-switch exports GATE and RETURN, fixes output_current to 0.1 A, and internally connects Q1 SOURCE (pin 2) to GND and DRAIN (pin 3) to RETURN; VLOAD connects only to the catch diode. block:g2-relay-channels exports two POWER_SINK returns, fixes output_current to 0.1 A per active channel, grounds ULN2003 emitter pin 8, and connects VLOAD to COM pin 9, not to a commanded high-side source. The inspected underlying part contracts confirm an N-channel MOSFET and a common-emitter Darlington sink array, respectively; these are not exported three-half-bridge motor contracts. The complete 55-part role listing contains no motor-inverter or half-bridge driver contract. Merely duplicating these low-side blocks or relabeling their returns U/V/W cannot implement a source phase, sink phase and floating phase with the six external control inputs at the required 0.50 A winding current and 10 kHz PWM. A newly qualified inverter block would be needed; substituting a different topology or inventing a block would violate the supplied brief and verified-catalog synthesis rules. This is a selection refusal, not an assertion that a qualified three-phase circuit is physically impossible.
